name: @vismay/randomizer
description: The Vizmaya story randomizers (Desk, Atlas, Epics): datasets, the one shared draw (heat weighting, region and tradition balancing, quotas, repeat blocks, locks), the spin's agent-brief sections and research stub, the randomizer_spins / desk_heat readers and writers, and the daily trend snapshot (Xpoz) every spin's brief reads. Pure modules are client-safe; ./spins and ./trendsServer are server only.
